findings.title: traceID field silently dropped from plugin request completion log
findings.body: The old logRequest explicitly appended a "traceID" field to the log params when a trace ID was present in the context. That code is removed, and the new contextual logger (ContextualLoggerMiddleware/instrumentContext) only attaches endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname. Unless the infra logger's FromContext adds the trace ID on its own, completion logs for plugin requests lose the traceID, which breaks correlating these log lines with traces. The PR description says it only moves the contextual logger, so this is an unintended regression.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext returns a fresh logger, so logs written through it are lost
findings.body: FromContext ignores the receiver and returns NewTestLogger(). LoggerMiddleware now calls m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so with a TestLogger injected, the "Plugin Request Completed" entry is recorded on a throwaway logger and the test's InfoLogs stay empty. Any test asserting on the logged output of LoggerMiddleware will silently pass or fail for the wrong reason. FromContext should return the receiver (or share its log storage) so calls are visible to the test.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no test coverage
findings.body: This file is new and takes over the contextual-attribute enrichment that was previously tested as part of the instrumentation middleware. Nothing in the PR adds a test for ContextualLoggerMiddleware, and the existing metrics test no longer exercises instrumentContext. Its attribute assembly (endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname) and its placement in the chain are therefore unverified.

findings.title: Test function name still refers to the old InstrumentationMiddleware name
findings.body: The file was renamed to metrics_middleware_test.go and the type is now MetricsMiddleware, but the test is still named TestInstrumentationMiddleware. This is inconsistent with the rename the PR is meant to do and makes the test harder to find when searching for MetricsMiddleware.
